# AIDrift CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:generate` from Commander metadata in `packages/cli/src`. Do not edit manually. -->

AIDrift uses process exit `0` for success, `1` for a behavioral or validation failure, and `2` for configuration/runtime errors. Individual command descriptions below are generated from the executable CLI registration.

## `aidrift`

Global options and command routing.

Version, diff, test, and gate AI system behavior.

**Usage**

`aidrift [options] [command]`

**Options**

| Flags                 | Description                                   | Default |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-V, --version`       | Print version                                 | —       |
| `-c, --config <path>` | Path to .aistate.yml                          | —       |
| `-v, --verbose`       | Verbose output                                | —       |
| `--debug`             | Debug output with secrets redacted            | —       |
| `-q, --quiet`         | Suppress non-error output                     | —       |
| `--no-color`          | Disable colored output                        | —       |
| `-f, --format <fmt>`  | Output format (when supported by the command) | —       |
| `-h, --help`          | Print help                                    | —       |

## `aidrift check`

CI/CD quality gate: run evals against latest baseline, exit 1 on regression.

**Usage**

`aidrift check [options]`

**Options**

| Flags                         | Description                                                                  | Default |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --config <path>`         | Path to .aistate.yml                                                         | —       |
| `--format <fmt>`              | Output format: text, json, junit, or github                                  | —       |
| `--baseline <sha-or-tag>`     | Snapshot id, label, tag, or git SHA to use as baseline                       | —       |
| `--output <path>`             | Also write formatted output to this file                                     | —       |
| `--fail-on <level>`           | Failure threshold: fail (default) or warn                                    | `fail`  |
| `--assertions <ids>`          | Run only specific assertion IDs (comma-separated)                            | —       |
| `--tags <tags>`               | Run only assertions matching tags (comma-separated)                          | —       |
| `--samples <n>`               | Samples per assertion and provider probe                                     | —       |
| `--probe-model <name>`        | Run probes only for one model artifact                                       | —       |
| `--probe-category <category>` | Probe category: deterministic, structural, semantic, behavioral, performance | —       |
| `--concurrency <n>`           | Maximum concurrent evals and probes                                          | `4`     |
| `--timeout <seconds>`         | Total wall-clock execution deadline                                          | —       |
| `--cost-budget <dollars>`     | Required maximum USD cost for live providers; unknown cost fails closed      | —       |
| `-h, --help`                  | Print help                                                                   | —       |

## `aidrift validate`

Validate the .aistate.yml manifest file.

**Usage**

`aidrift validate [options]`

**Options**

| Flags        | Description                           | Default |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--strict`   | Treat validation warnings as failures | —       |
| `-h, --help` | Print help                            | —       |

## `aidrift init`

Scan a project directory and generate a .aistate.yml manifest.

**Usage**

`aidrift init [options]`

**Options**

| Flags               | Description                                                            | Default |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--dir <path>`      | Directory to scan (default: cwd)                                       | —       |
| `--dry-run`         | Print manifest to stdout instead of writing to disk                    | —       |
| `--force`           | Overwrite an existing .aistate.yml manifest                            | —       |
| `-y, --yes`         | Skip interactive confirmation, accept all detected artifacts           | —       |
| `--template <name>` | Skip scanner, use a built-in template (basic-llm, rag-pipeline, agent) | —       |
| `-h, --help`        | Print help                                                             | —       |

## `aidrift snapshot`

Capture artifact state and optional behavioral baselines.

**Usage**

`aidrift snapshot [options]`

**Options**

| Flags                     | Description                                                      | Default |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --config <path>`     | Path to .aistate.yml                                             | —       |
| `--label <label>`         | Human-readable label for this snapshot                           | —       |
| `-m, --message <message>` | Description for this snapshot                                    | —       |
| `--tags <tags>`           | Comma-separated snapshot tags                                    | —       |
| `--with-evals`            | Capture evaluation baselines                                     | —       |
| `--with-probes`           | Capture provider-drift probe baselines                           | —       |
| `--provider <provider>`   | Baseline provider: mock, openai, or anthropic                    | `mock`  |
| `--samples <n>`           | Samples per eval assertion and provider probe                    | `5`     |
| `--yes`                   | Confirm live provider calls and accept estimated cost            | —       |
| `--cost-budget <dollars>` | Maximum allowed live baseline cost in USD; exits 2 when exceeded | —       |
| `-h, --help`              | Print help                                                       | —       |

## `aidrift history`

List past snapshots in reverse chronological order.

**Usage**

`aidrift history [options]`

**Options**

| Flags                 | Description                                  | Default |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --config <path>` | Path to .aistate.yml                         | —       |
| `--limit <n>`         | Maximum number of snapshots to show          | `20`    |
| `--since <date>`      | Show snapshots at or after an ISO-8601 date  | —       |
| `--until <date>`      | Show snapshots at or before an ISO-8601 date | —       |
| `--show-changes`      | Include changed artifact details             | —       |
| `--labels-only`       | Show only labeled snapshots                  | —       |
| `--format <fmt>`      | Output format: text, json                    | —       |
| `-h, --help`          | Print help                                   | —       |

## `aidrift diff`

Diff latest/specified baseline against current state, or compare two snapshots.

**Usage**

`aidrift diff [options] [snap_a] [snap_b]`

**Arguments**

| Name     | Required | Variadic | Description |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `snap_a` | no       | no       | —           |
| `snap_b` | no       | no       | —           |

**Options**

| Flags                 | Description                                 | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --config <path>` | Path to .aistate.yml                        | —       |
| `--format <fmt>`      | Output format: text, json, markdown         | —       |
| `--stat`              | Show summary statistics only                | —       |
| `--artifact <name>`   | Show a specific artifact or artifact prefix | —       |
| `-h, --help`          | Print help                                  | —       |

## `aidrift plan`

Execute the declared eval target and compare sampled behavior to a baseline.

**Usage**

`aidrift plan [options]`

**Options**

| Flags                      | Description                                                 | Default |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --config <path>`      | Path to .aistate.yml                                        | —       |
| `--assertions <ids>`       | Run only specific assertions (comma-separated)              | —       |
| `--tags <tags>`            | Run assertions matching tags (comma-separated)              | —       |
| `--samples <n>`            | Override samples per assertion                              | —       |
| `--allow-regression <ids>` | Mark assertion ids as intentionally regressed               | —       |
| `--budget <amount>`        | Maximum eval cost in USD (for example, $0.50)               | —       |
| `--timeout <seconds>`      | Maximum total eval execution time                           | —       |
| `--dry-run`                | Show what would be tested without invoking the provider     | —       |
| `--probe-providers`        | Include provider drift probes                               | —       |
| `--provider <provider>`    | Provider for --probe-providers: mock, openai, or anthropic  | `mock`  |
| `--yes`                    | Confirm live provider run and accept estimated cost         | —       |
| `--cost-budget <dollars>`  | Maximum allowed cost in USD; exits 2 if estimate exceeds it | —       |
| `--format <fmt>`           | Output format: text or json                                 | —       |
| `--save`                   | Save results to .aidrift/results/                           | —       |
| `--concurrency <n>`        | Maximum concurrent assertions                               | `4`     |
| `-h, --help`               | Print help                                                  | —       |

## `aidrift probe`

Detect provider-side drift with canonical provider probes.

**Usage**

`aidrift probe [options]`

**Options**

| Flags                     | Description                                                                  | Default |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-c, --config <path>`     | Path to .aistate.yml                                                         | —       |

| `--category <category>`   | Probe category: deterministic, structural, semantic, behavioral, performance | —       |
| `--samples <n>`           | Samples per probe                                                            | `5`     |
| `--timeout <seconds>`     | Maximum total provider probe execution time                                  | —       |
| `--cache-ttl <mins>`      | Cache TTL in minutes                                                         | `60`    |
| `--no-cache`              | Disable probe result caching                                                 | —       |
| `--estimate-cost`         | Show estimated probe cost without running probes                             | —       |
| `--format <fmt>`          | Output format: text or json                                                  | —       |
| `--concurrency <n>`       | Maximum concurrent probes                                                    | `4`     |
| `--provider <provider>`   | Provider: mock, openai, or anthropic                                         | `mock`  |
| `--yes`                   | Confirm live provider run and accept estimated cost                          | —       |
| `--cost-budget <dollars>` | Maximum allowed cost in USD; exits 2 if estimate exceeds it                  | —       |
| `-h, --help`              | Print help                                                                   | —       |
